title: Himmatwar
desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: A naive village girl marries the son of a domineering man. However, upon her arrival at his house in the city, she finds out that he is already married.

title: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
desc: Arun Khanna, an Indian spy, collaborates with Reshma to stop a nuclear attack. However, Reshma's identity is compromised during her undercover mission in Pakistan.

title: Judaai
desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

title: Diya
desc: Thulasi, a young woman, accidentally gets pregnant before marriage and is forced to abort the child by her family. Years later, she is visited by the spirit of her unborn daughter.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.
